title: Implement Merkle-CRDT append operation for group log
description:
Implement append(entry: LogEntry) on GroupLog: compute the CID of the new entry (canonical serialization + SHA2-256), set parent_cids to current tip set, update tip set to {new_cid}, persist entry to storage. Artifact: src/group_log/append.rs in usenet-ipfs-core.

Acceptance:
- append() is idempotent for duplicate entries (same CID, no-op)
- append() maintains the invariant: every entry's parent_cids exist in the log
- Concurrent appends on two replicas diverge into a multi-tip state
- Unit test: single-node sequence produces a valid chain
- Unit test: concurrent appends produce a valid DAG
